main_body: stack of three cylindrical cheese wheels (two on the bottom, one centered on top)
top_band: 2px pale yellow band on the top wheel (rows 4-5, plus a 1px nub at row 3 col 8) and a 1-2px light yellow band on the bottom wheels (rows 9-10 at the outer edges, reduced to 1px at row 10 under the upper wheel)
evidence: Reading down the center column of the upper wheel (col 7-8): after a 1px stray pixel on row 3, rows 4-5 form only a 2px pale-yellow top band before dropping into a flat 3px medium-gold front face (rows 6-8) and 1px dark brown base (row 9). The lower wheels similarly have only a 1-2px top band (rows 9-10, only 1px tall at row 10 across the middle) above a 3px flat front face (rows 11-13). This matches the 'barrel: lid 2px' rim-only failure in the guide rather than showing foreshortened elliptical cylinder tops.

style.evidence: The entire sprite uses only 4 colours (pale yellow, light yellow, mid gold, dark brown outline). The vertical front faces of all three cylindrical wheels (7x3px on the top wheel, 5x3px and 7x3px on the bottom wheels) are filled with a single flat gold colour with no cylindrical left-to-right shading ramp, no contact shadows, and no surface texture.
